question: All of the following concerning the ureters are true EXCEPT:
options: They are lined with transitional epithelium
They have a thin serosa layer
They show prominent longitudinal folds in the mucosa
They have several layers of smooth muscle in the musculosa
They conduct urine from renal pelvis to urinary bladder
explanation: The ureter is retroperitoneal and does NOT have a complete serosa; it is surrounded by a loose adventitia that blends with surrounding retroperitoneal connective tissue.
pearl: الحالب يغطى بطبقة البرانية (Adventitia) وليس مصلية (Serosa) كاملة لكونه عضواً خلف البريتوان.

question: Muscularis of the urinary bladder is arranged as:
options: Inner and outer circular and middle longitudinal layers
Inner and outer longitudinal and middle circular
Inner circular and outer longitudinal layers
Inner longitudinal and outer circular layers
Inner and middle longitudinal and outer circular layers
explanation: The muscularis of the urinary bladder (Detrusor muscle) consists of 3 interdigitating smooth muscle layers: inner longitudinal, middle circular, and outer longitudinal.
pearl: عضلة المثانة الدافعة (Detrusor) تتكون من ثلاث طبقات: طولية داخلية، دائرية وسطى، وطولية خارجية.
